rules: Each value retains its native system boundary and evidence class.
Cell PCE is not array specific power or deployed plant efficiency.
Programme goals and design targets are not achieved hardware results.
Published experimental results are not space-qualified or lunar-qualified unless the source says so.
Unknown values are omitted, never inferred from a nearby metric.
